svg.aria-label: Tools: Python, R, SQL and MySQL for data work. Tableau and Power BI for showing results. Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, Tailwind and Bootstrap for building things. Also AWS, Figma and Arduino.

g.text: Python, R and SQL for most of my data work.
Tableau and Power BI when the results need to
Java and JavaScript for uni and client builds,
with HTML, CSS, Tailwind and Bootstrap on
the web side. AWS, Figma and Arduino come
data on its way to a chart
